items.title: Amino acids ki activation aur translation ke marhale (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Protein banne se pehle ikaiyan tayyar hoti hain: khaas tRNAs khaas amino acids se jur kar aminoacyl-tRNAs (aa-tRNA) banate hain. Yeh kaam enzyme aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase karta hai; is ki 20 qismein hain, har aik aik amino acid se jurti aur us ke anticodon wale tRNAs pehchanti hai. aa-tRNA amino acid ribosome tak pohanchata hai.

blocks.alt: Amino acid jama ATP jama mutabiq tRNA, jo neeche anticodon wale dabbe ki shakal mein hai, aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase enzyme par mil kar aminoacyl-tRNA dete hain, yaani wahi tRNA jis ke oopar amino acid jura hai.
blocks.caption: Aminoacyl-tRNA banana (Figure 19.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Protein banne se pehle har amino acid apne tRNA se jorra jata hai, yaani aminoacyl-tRNA (aa-tRNA) banta hai. Yeh kaam enzyme aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase karta hai; is ki 20 qismein hain, har amino acid ke liye aik, aur har aik apne amino acid aur us amino acid ke anticodon wale tRNAs ko pehchanta hai. aa-tRNA apna amino acid ribosome tak le jata hai jahan us ka anticodon mRNA ke codon se jurta hai.

items: Pehla amino acid le jane wala aa-tRNA chhoti ribosomal subunit se jurta hai, jise initiation factor qaboo karta hai. Prokaryotes mein pehla amino acid N-formyl-methionine aur eukaryotes mein bagair tabdeeli methionine hai.
Aik aur initiation factor mRNA ka 5' sira chhoti subunit se jorta aur aa-tRNA ka anticodon pehle codon, AUG, par rakhta hai.
Bari subunit aa milti hai. Ab initiation complex mein dono subunits, pehla aa-tRNA, mRNA aur factors hain.

jahan se khaali tRNAs nikalte hain

blocks.text: mRNA ke saath yeh jaghein 5' se 3' tak E-P-A tarteeb mein hain, kyunke ribosome 3' sire ki taraf chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen panel, surkh mRNA (AUG, UUU, GGC, UAA) par ribosome, bari subunit par E, P aur A. Initiation: UAC anticodon wala tRNA Met le kar AUG par P mein. Elongation: Met-tRNA P par aur Phe-tRNA (AAA) A par, peptide bond banta. Termination: P par tRNA zanjeer pakre, A mein stop codon UAA par release factor, aur polypeptide chhoot jata.
blocks.caption: Initiation, elongation aur termination (Figures 19.18 se 19.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Initiation: pehla amino acid (prokaryotes mein N-formyl-methionine, eukaryotes mein methionine) le jane wala aa-tRNA initiation factor ki madad se chhoti ribosomal subunit se jurta, mRNA ka 5' sira lagta taa ke anticodon start codon AUG par aaye, aur bari subunit aa milti hai. Ribosome mein P site, A site aur E site hain, 5' se 3' tarteeb E-P-A. Elongation: mutabiq anticodon wala aa-tRNA elongation factor ke saath A site mein aata; peptidyl transferase P site ke tRNA ki zanjeer ko naye amino acid se peptide bond se jorta; ribosome teen nucleotides 3' ki taraf sarakta (translocation), zanjeer P aur khaali tRNA E par. Termination: stop codon par koi tRNA fit nahi; release factor polypeptide chhorta aur subunits alag ho jati hain.

items: Agla aa-tRNA, mutabiq anticodon aur amino acid ke saath, elongation factor ki madad se A site se jurta hai.
Peptidyl transferase P site ke tRNA se amino acid (pehli baar methionine) hata kar A site ke tRNA ke amino acid se peptide bond se jorta hai.
Ribosome mRNA par 5' se 3' ki simt mein teen nucleotides sarakta hai (translocation).
Zanjeer wala tRNA A se P site par aata, A par naya codon khulta, aur khaali tRNA E par ja kar nikal jata hai.
Yeh qadam dohraye jate hain jab tak stop codon A site par na aa jaye.

blocks.text: Jab stop codon A site par ho to koi aa-tRNA nahi aata kyunke kisi tRNA ka stop codon ke liye anticodon nahi. Release factor naam ka protein stop codon pehchaan kar P site ke tRNA se polypeptide chhorta hai; tRNA chhoot jata aur ribosomal subunits mRNA se alag ho jati hain.

blocks.prompt: mRNA AUG UUU GGC UAA hai. Polypeptide mein kitne amino acids hain aur ise kya rokta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teen: methionine, phenylalanine aur glycine. UAA stop codon hai; release factor A site par us se jur kar zanjeer chhorta hai.

items: 20 aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases tRNAs tayyar karte hain.
AUG par (f)Met-tRNA P site mein: initiation.
Elongation: A site mein aamad, peptide bond, 3 nucleotides translocation.
